name: u_bandpass2
notes: RBJ unity-peak-gain bandpass coefficient generator, not an audio processor. Both frequency and bandwidth inputs are hot. At SR22050/f1000 it must output [2*cos(w)/(1+alpha), -(1-alpha)/(1+alpha), b0/(1+alpha), b1/(1+alpha), b2/(1+alpha)] in Pd biquad order. Source scales bandwidth by 0.01: 100 units per octave; alpha=sin(w)*sinh(log(2)/2*BW*w/sin(w)). Creation values prevent zero-width startup; repeated equal values and bang must reproduce the same five coefficients.
